verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a developer-facing agent product, since Grok Build exposes headless/JSON output and ACP JSON-RPC interfaces, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples. The only API-reference signal is a probe finding an openapi.json at docs.x.ai, which covers the general xAI REST API rather than Grok Build. A raw spec file is also not an interactive reference with runnable examples.
